blocks.text: Cloverdale Lots & Land — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of vacant land and building lots are sold in Cloverdale?

include serviced single-family building lots created through infill subdivision, older teardown properties sold primarily for lot value, Neighbourhood Concept Plan (NCP) assembly parcels in Clayton, and Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) acreage parcels.
How do I check zoning and subdivision potential on a Cloverdale lot?

Use the City of Surrey COSMOS mapping system to verify the lot's current zoning, Official Community Plan (OCP) designation, secondary Neighbourhood Concept Plan status, water/sanitary/storm main locations, road-dedication requirements, and riparian streamside protection setbacks.
Does GST apply when buying a vacant building lot in Cloverdale?

GST (5%) frequently applies to sales of vacant subdivided lots sold by developers or GST-registered builders, and can also apply to certain newly subdivided parcels. Always have a CPA or real estate lawyer verify GST applicability before submitting an offer on land.
What are Development Cost Charges (DCCs) and servicing costs in Surrey?

When subdividing or building on raw land in Surrey, buyers must budget for municipal Development Cost Charges (DCCs), Metro Vancouver regional charges, latecomer agreements (if prior developers funded nearby mains), road/sidewalk frontage works, and BC Hydro underground service connections.
How does Surrey's Tree Protection Bylaw affect building on a Cloverdale lot?

City of Surrey Tree Protection Bylaw regulates the removal of protected trees above specified trunk diameters and sets replacement-tree ratios or cash-in-lieu fees during demolition, subdivision, and building-permit applications. An arborist report is standard for treed lots.
What down payment is required for vacant land financing in BC?

Canadian banks and credit unions typically require 35% to 50% down for raw or unserviced land, and 25% to 35% down for fully serviced urban residential building lots where a construction draw mortgage is being arranged.
